decisive_items: Multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae on the face, trunk, and extremities
Whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1
response.rationale: The patient's clinical presentation and genetic mutation are consistent with Bullous Congenital Ichthyosiform Erythroderma

rejected.why: While Epidermolytic Hyperkeratosis is a possible diagnosis, the genetic mutation and clinical presentation are more consistent with Bullous Congenital Ichthyosiform Erythroderma
